newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa finance team to visit new Congo "in days".
newsitem.headline: S.Africa finance team to visit new Congo "in days".

text.p: A South African team of senior technical advisors will visit the new Democratic Republic of Congo within days to help the country start rebuilding after its civil war, Deputy President Thabo Mbeki said on Thursday.

"We have an agreement with the government (of Laurent Kabila) to discuss with them a variety of matters that impact on the socio-economic situation there," Mbeki told journalists at the launch of a U.N. Development Programme report on poverty.

"So we'll be sending a delegation in the next few days to Kinshasa. They requested that we compose a delegation which would include for instance the Reserve Bank, the economic ministries, people dealing with infrastructure, people who deal with public administration, and so on," Mbeki said.
He said this was an example of the determination of the countries of southern Africa to do something to help themselves.

"But I think generally the rest of the world needs to accept that this is an important challenge, and if one is talking about success in African development...the success of this Democratic Republic of Congo is very critical," Mbeki said.
